Use case: stylized-concept. Production artwork for Crown & Kingdoms, a premium medieval isometric RTS. This is a REAL transparent sprite sheet asset, NOT a poster, dashboard, presentation, game screen, UI card, infographic, storyboard with captions, or layout concept. Image 1 is the existing character identity/style REFERENCE ONLY (existing 8-column by 6-row base unit sheet); Image 2 is the existing hand-painted 4 by 4 animation sheet style reference. Render EXACTLY ONE CHARACTER per panel and EXACTLY SIXTEEN independent full-body poses in a strict 4-column by 4-row 1536x1024 PNG, no gaps replaced by labels. Cells are 384x256 (4 columns, 4 rows). Top two rows cell order 1-8: eight consecutive true articulated walking animation frames. Bottom two rows cell order 9-16: eight consecutive action frames, frame nine is a complete neutral standing ready pose. Match all 16 poses to the same body proportions, costume, facial identity, silhouette, equipment, painterly brush quality, earth-toned neutral materials, dark crisp readable outlines, top-left lighting, and vivid COBALT BLUE recolourable heraldic cloth. Perspective is locked at 30-degree elevated isometric, facing screen RIGHT and slightly toward viewer; no turntable/directional rotation. Every panel has the same foot baseline and character body scale, with 16 pixels transparent inset inside nominal cell edges (long tips compactly angled rather than clipped). Entire figures, held weapons and feet visible INSIDE nominal cell bounds, nothing crosses into another cell. True alpha-zero transparent background for all empty pixels, no checkerboard, gradient, floor, cast ground shadow, backdrop, text, logo, watermarks, number labels, frame borders, artboard background, extra limbs, floating weapons, duplicate frames, motion smears, separate props, muzzle blasts that escape cells, or cropped anatomy.

Subject: Ottoman Janissary with a very tall rigid ivory-white felt börk headdress, crimson-red long lower tunic, vivid cobalt blue outer clothing, tan sash, brown boots and a single long wood-stock black-metal matchlock musket. Preserve the unmistakable tall white headdress at every pose. No European crossbow, bow, sword or modern rifle.

Walking: Walk with long musket shouldered or carried diagonally, alternate planted left and right legs, natural cloth movement and consistent head size.

Action: Nine ready upright with musket held safely; ten lower to priming stance; eleven operate matchlock or charging hand; twelve raise and sight the weapon; thirteen fire a single musket shot with shoulder recoil; fourteen recover from kick; fifteen lower and reset musket; sixteen return to ready. Never draw a detached muzzle projectile.

Weapon: One long matchlock musket with complete single barrel and stock, hands connected, never two guns.

Verify alpha transparency and all 16 individual poses before packaging. Do not count this brief as finished artwork.
